julesThoughtProcess: I chose Electric Blue (#00E5FF) to evoke the glow of bioluminescent algae and city neon, a nod to organic life finding a way amidst the urban sprawl. The story focuses on the grounded reality of a robotics mechanic.
storyPanel: Even with an arm mostly made of salvaged synth-muscle and brushed steel, Eli’s touch with the older model companion-bots was legendary. 'They just need a little patience, and maybe some new servos,' he’d say, watching the neon city hum outside his dusty repair shop window. It wasn't an easy living, but keeping the city's metallic heartbeat going was work worth doing.
